title: Stripe powers new Deel Card that lets contractors spend their earnings in stablecoins globally
summary: Stripe today announced that Deel is using Stripe Issuing to enable contractors around the world to spend their stablecoin balances with the new Deel Card.
body_markdown:
SAN FRANCISCO AND DUBLIN—Stripe today announced that Deel is using Stripe Issuing to enable contractors around the world to spend their stablecoin balances with the new Deel Card.


Deel is a global payroll and HR platform trusted by over 40,000 businesses to hire, manage, and pay teams across more than 150 countries. Today, the company is launching a new Deel Card that lets contractors spend their stablecoin balances as easily as traditional fiat currency and offers up to 1.5% cashback, plus travel and purchase protection. The Deel Card is powered by Stripe in 26 markets across Latin America, the Caribbean, and Africa.


“Stablecoins should be as easy to spend as any money you’ve ever held,” said Henri Stern, head of crypto and stablecoins at Stripe. “Stripe’s stablecoin stack already helped contractors hold stablecoins with Deel, and we’re thrilled to now enable them to spend their earnings on everyday purchases, anywhere a card is accepted.”


Deel processes payroll for employers and pays contractors compliantly around the world. Once paid, contractors can withdraw their funds or convert their balance into DLUSD, Deel's USD-denominated custom stablecoin. That balance sits in a stablecoin wallet on Deel, and the new card lets them spend directly from it. Under the hood, the system runs on Stripe's infrastructure, using[Bridge](https://www.bridge.xyz/) to issue the stablecoin and[Privy](https://www.privy.io/) to power the wallet.


“Contractors already use the Deel stablecoin wallet to hold their pay and be eligible to earn rewards on it, and since June, they’ve kept over $45 million there,” said Thierry Edde, head of crypto at Deel. “Today, we’re giving them a way to spend it with the new Deel Card. That means contractors can hold, earn, and now spend, all on Deel. There’s no more moving money between apps and losing time, fees, and value along the way.”


While most crypto transactions are typically publicly visible on a blockchain, Deel keeps contractor balances and payment activity private. This is made possible by Privy’s native integration with[Tempo Zones](https://tempo.com/zones/) , where each contractor’s wallet is visible only to them and to Deel as the Zone’s operator, not the public.


*The Prepaid Debit Visa Card (“Card”) is issued by Lead Bank under license from Visa U.S.A. Inc. Bridge Ventures LLC is the financial technology company, not a bank, and is the Program Manager that manages and operates the Card on behalf of Lead Bank. Deel is not a bank. Deel is a financial technology company and is the Platform Provider responsible for the application, access, and management of the card. Must be 18+ to be eligible. Fees may apply. DLUSD is a digital USD balance. It is not a bank account or legal tender, and it is not FDIC-insured. Stablecoin features are provided by licensed third-party partners and are subject to eligibility. Rewards are promotional, are not interest or investment returns, and may change. Visa benefits are subject to issuer terms and exclusions. Terms apply.*
